M1.title: M1: Composing modules into machines
M1.description: Parts with start/done contracts, evolved and verified on their own, wired by port type, composed by search and promoted into new parts, ending in arithmetic. Spec: the Claude Doc 'Composing SN P Modules into Machines' and RESEARCH.md.

M2.title: M2: Toward hardware
M2.description: A hardware rule profile, exporters checked by co-simulation, bounded contract verification, streaming tasks and timing robustness. Spec: 'Use cases and a practical path' in RESEARCH.md.

M3.title: M3: Toward general synthesis
M3.description: Parts without hand-building, programs of parts lowered to compositions, proofs that scale with the hierarchy, binary and parameterised parts. Spec: 'Toward general synthesis' in RESEARCH.md.

M4.title: M4: Spec to verified circuit
M4.description: An algorithm spec in, the smallest verified spiking circuit out: specs as targets, superoptimisation with verification steps, a usable spec-file tool with hardware bundles, and arithmetic records against hand designs. Spec: 'Spec to verified circuit' in RESEARCH.md.
